baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predication kaanat habaa'an munbaththan makes an implicit feminine subject enter a dust-state qualified by dispersal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal coming-to-be converts a bounded but unnamed subject into fine matter; the adjective makes loss of cohesion, not dust alone, the endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time make the clause a realized state transition.
Fine, dispersed motes supply the particulate state into which the subject passes.
Spreading and scattering material make de-cohesion the operative result.

changed_reading.before: An unnamed subject simply becomes dust.
changed_reading.after: An unnamed subject undergoes a completed phase change from coherent form into mobile, unbound particles.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Habaa'an and munbaththan combine airborne dust with active diffusion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dust branches couple rising material with motes disclosed by light, while the dispersal branch distributes them through a field of view. The transition therefore produces a new visibility regime as well as residue.

activation_trace.role: Dust rising in air supplies suspension and upward mobility.
Fine motes seen in a shaft of light make dispersion an act of particulate disclosure.
Material spread turns isolated dust into a pervasive visible field.

changed_reading.before: The dust is inert residue lying where it fell.
changed_reading.after: The dust is suspended and distributed, so former solidity survives only as innumerable visible traces.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The habaa' predicate admits both spent ash and the image of empty hands.
baseline_models.mechanism: The state change can register terminal exhaustion: substance cools into residue, mixes with earth, and leaves nothing graspable to retain.

activation_trace.role: Coming to be marks the residue as an achieved terminal condition.
Extinguished ash mixed with soil supplies the image of spent material.
Hands shaken empty convert material exhaustion into dispossession.

changed_reading.before: Becoming dust describes only reduction in particle size.
changed_reading.after: Becoming dust also images extinguishment and the loss of anything that can still be possessed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence identifies an elevated solid mass and supplies a process: a severe event agitates it, crumbling and mixing destroy its internal cohesion, and 56:6 states the resulting aerosolized residue.

activation_trace.role: Fine dispersed dust supplies the process endpoint.
Scattering carries the comminuted residue away from its former mass.
The severe descending event supplies the initiating rupture.
Agitation until disturbance supplies the first mechanical operation.
Crumbling, wetting, and mixing supply the loss of internal binding.
An elevated solid aggregate identifies the coherent input destroyed by the process.

structural_cues: Ayat 56:4-6 form a process sequence: intensified shaking, intensified crumbling, then resultative fa- in 56:6; feminine singular kaanat resumes the nonhuman plural mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a severe event, repeated agitation, crumbling and mixing, and an elevated solid mass; I infer the arrow agitation -> comminution -> airborne residue. A live alternative is that the ayat enumerate concurrent signs rather than a mechanical chain.

changed_reading.before: An unidentified entity becomes scattered dust without a stated pathway.
changed_reading.after: The mountains are processed from resistant elevated aggregates into fine mobile matter through a staged collapse of cohesion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The vertical pair of lowering and raising, the mountain's elevated solidity, and the split-root image of spreading over level ground activate a topological reading: height is converted into a horizontally undifferentiated particulate field.

activation_trace.role: Fine motes provide the level field's undifferentiated units.
Lateral spreading removes the particles from a single elevated center.
The alternate mapped image of extension in a level place supplies an exploratory spatial endpoint.
Lowering after height supplies the downward transformation.
Raising establishes the vertical axis that the dusting of heights disrupts.
The elevated solid aggregate supplies the height and differentiation being nullified.

structural_cues: The lowering/raising pair in 56:3 precedes the named high masses in 56:5 and their dispersed state in 56:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an alternate mapped branch of level extension, a down/up pair, and elevated solidity; I infer a height-to-field arrow. The alternate mapping may be form-distant, and lowering/raising may concern rank rather than geometry.

changed_reading.before: Scattering is random motion after breakage.
changed_reading.after: Scattering materially abolishes vertical distinction, turning what dominated the horizon into an even field of particles.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate repetition of the becoming construction links two contrary reorganizations: the mountains lose all grouping into scattered particles, then the human audience acquires grouping as three kinds.

activation_trace.role: Material scattering supplies the ungrouping side of the contrast.
A second realized state transition links human classification to the material transition.
Kinds or classes supply the regrouping that follows material dispersal.
The number three makes the new human order explicit and bounded.

structural_cues: Ayah 56:7 immediately follows 56:6 and repeats k-w-n in the perfect while changing from an implicit nonhuman subject to second-person plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent state changes, first dispersion and then threefold grouping; I infer a contrastive arrow from material ungrouping to human regrouping. The live alternative is a simple subject shift with no designed parallel.

changed_reading.before: The dust-state is the end of order.
changed_reading.after: The dust-state is a threshold: one old order is dissolved immediately before persons are sorted into a new, explicit order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later images systematically restore relations absent from dust: a gathered group, tight interweaving, mutual facing, and circulation around a center. Cohesion is not erased universally; it is withdrawn from the old landscape and reassigned to an ordered community.

activation_trace.role: Unbounded spreading supplies the decentered pole of the mechanism.
A gathered group restores collective cohesion after particulate dispersal.
Tight interwoven construction supplies material binding as the inverse of dust.
A group facing one another converts proximity into reciprocal social order.
Circulation around a center replaces uncontrolled diffusion with directed motion.

structural_cues: After the 56:6 dispersal and 56:7 classification, 56:13-17 accumulates gathering, interweaving, face-to-face arrangement, and centered circulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered, interwoven, mutually facing, and orbiting configurations; I read their accumulation as a designed inverse of decentered dust. They may instead be independent descriptions of reward with no backward pressure on 56:6.

changed_reading.before: Dust signifies a universal collapse of structure.
changed_reading.after: Dust marks selective de-structuring: old material cohesion vanishes while a new social and spatial cohesion is assembled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later accounting frame contrasts what receives a due return with what is cast aside as uncounted. Read backward, the empty-handed dust-state is not only physical waste but the cancellation of a former structure's claim to lasting value.

activation_trace.role: Empty hands supply the focus image of dispossession and failed retention.
Returning an action's due establishes the positive accounting pole.
Purposeful action identifies what remains legible for recompense.
A discarded thing not taken into account supplies the negative valuation pole.

structural_cues: Ayah 56:24 explicitly links recompense to what people were doing, and 56:25 immediately excludes laghw from the resulting domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompensed action, purposeful work, uncounted discard, and the focus image of empty hands; I infer that physical residue also signals devaluation. The alternative is that laghw governs speech alone and contributes no material analogy.

changed_reading.before: The dust is merely leftover matter.
changed_reading.after: The dust is matter stripped of standing and retention, contrasted with actions that remain countable enough to receive their due.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the disclosure branch of b-th-th usually concerns news or inward distress and because pearl imagery is later and cross-domain. It remains anchored in munbaththan, light-visible habaa', and the packet's protective concealment branch. Render it only as a secondary exposure/containment analogy, not as a lexical replacement for scattered dust.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjective munbaththan qualifies fine habaa', allowing literal particulate spread to carry a secondary image of exposed contents.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of what was concealed lets material breakup double as exposure of an interior.
Fine motes visible in light supply exposed, individually perceptible particles.
The compact pearl supplies a valuable particulate counter-image to dust.
Protective concealment opposes the dust's total exposure and diffusion.

changed_reading.before: Breakup exposes no meaningful inside; it only makes smaller pieces.
changed_reading.after: The mass is turned inside out as exposed motes, an anti-pearl state opposed to compact value kept under protection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the packet's non-dominant mapping of j-z-y to j-z-z and is therefore deliberately branch-distant. Its image of what falls through shearing remains materially anchored in habaa' and munbaththan. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory analogy, never the contextual meaning of jazaa'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Fine scattered residue can be compared to material that falls away when a whole is cut.

activation_trace.role: Fine particulate residue supplies the offcut-like material.
Scattering distributes what has been severed from coherent form.
The alternate split-root image of what falls by shearing recasts dust as judgment's material offcut.
Recompense for an act keeps the exploratory cutting image tied to the context's accounting operation.

changed_reading.before: The dust is accidental debris after collapse.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the dust resembles what a decisive sorting operation shears away from a former whole.

strongest_changes: Ayat 56:4-6 convert a generic dust-state into a causal sequence from resistant height through agitation and comminution to airborne residue.
The repeated k-w-n construction at 56:7 makes material dispersion a threshold immediately followed by threefold human classification.
Gathering, interweaving, mutual facing, and centered circulation in 56:13-17 relocate cohesion rather than letting 56:6 mean undifferentiated chaos alone.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported linked changes in material topology, social sorting, visibility, containment, and valuation while remaining anchored in kaanat, habaa', and munbaththan.
remaining_uncertainties: The lowering and raising pair may concern physical elevation, social rank, or both.
The non-dominant q-w-a and j-z-z mappings are productive but too form-distant for unqualified synthesis.
The exposure/protected-pearl contrast may be a useful material analogy without being a deliberate backward link.
